findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_release_calendar · Private data: get_onchain_quotes · Public sink: get_market_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_release_calendar · Private data: get_onchain_quotes · Public sink: get_market_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_country_list" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "List all 218 countries with metadata (region, income level, capital)." → after: "List all 217 countries and territories, plus the World aggregate, with metadata (region, income level, capital)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
